title: Specialization at the distinguished closed lift is transport
statement: Let s:Spec Ω→S be a geometric point and c:Spec Ω→S_(s) the distinguished lift given by the point evaluation ring map, so cg=s. For every abelian etale sheaf F, specialization s→c followed by transport along cg=s is the identity on F_s. For every bounded-below complex K, the derived specialization to c is precisely transport from K_s to K_(cg) along the inverse equality.

source.place: Tags 0GJ2 (specialization and Remark alternative-sp), 03Q9, 03QO and 0GJV (proof of lemma-specialization-cospecialization)

proof.text: On every affine pointed-neighbourhood germ, the defining section-cone restriction and the inverse-image stalk germ equation identify specialization with the germ at the lift through the limit leg. Point evaluation recovers the original marked lift at each limit leg. Stalk-colimit extensionality proves that specialization, followed by point transport, is the identity.

The derived specialization is the right-derived natural transformation conjugated by the exact-stalk comparison isomorphisms. After eliminating the equality of geometric points, the underived transformation is the identity, and right-derived functoriality and cancellation of the comparison isomorphisms prove the derived assertion.

theorem Etale.derivedEtaleStalkSpecialization_closed
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    (derivedEtaleStalkSpecialization s
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (strictHenselizationPointEvaluation s)))).app K =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun p : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S ↦
        (pointSmallEtale p).sheafFiber.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)
          (strictHenselizationClosedLift_over s).symm)
